rationale: A unanimous Court is most likely to adopt a narrow, text-focused venue holding: refinery-specific exemption decisions are “locally or regionally applicable” absent EPA’s contemporaneous “finds and publishes” nationwide-scope determination. Roberts or Kagan are the most probable authors because the conference centers on administrability and enforcing Congress’s explicit safety valve, with possible separate concurrences (especially from Gorsuch/Alito/Thomas) to emphasize separation-of-powers and reject any “practical effects” gloss.
